# WhaleLeap Studio

WhaleLeap Studio is a Shopify development studio operated by 深圳市知策先见智能科技有限公司 in Shenzhen, China.

## Services
- [Shopify website development](https://whaleleap.studio/services/shopify-website-build)
- [Shopify theme customization](https://whaleleap.studio/services/shopify-theme-customization)
- [Conversion rate optimization](https://whaleleap.studio/services/shopify-conversion-optimization)
- [GA4 / GTM tracking](https://whaleleap.studio/services/shopify-ga4-gtm)

## Pricing
The published starting prices are ¥20,000, ¥35,000, and ¥50,000. Scope and delivery terms are agreed per project.
See [pricing](https://whaleleap.studio/pricing).

## Who we work with
DTC brands, cross-border brands founded by Chinese entrepreneurs, and merchants moving from Amazon to an independent Shopify store.

- [SilkGear](https://whaleleap.studio/case-studies/silkgear)
